reasoning.text: The model spent many turns reading files and running into output truncation. It then tried to write a new module using a non-JSON tool-call format. The harness rejected it [T0B76:<RANGE>ERROR: Missing required fields: analysis, plan, commands</RANGE>]. After that the model kept emitting malformed tool_call markup. That markup never matches the JSON schema the harness requires [T0B0:<RANGE>Format your response as JSON with the following structure:</RANGE>]. From roughly the 87th block onward, the model repeated an identical python3 -c write command dozens of times, and every one was rejected with the same parse error. The run ended with a TrialBudgetExhaustedError after 95 episodes [R0M.trace_lab]. No edit ever landed and no code was fetched.
